subject: Post-call recap: ACME Health Private VPC discovery
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Jared Cole <jared.cole@acmehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: ACME Health Private VPC discovery

Hi Jared — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps. Please reply if I missed anything or if you'd like changes.

Key pain points you shared:
- Strict data residency: patient PII must remain in ACME-controlled VPC and not transit Redwood-hosted public endpoints.
- Air-gapped/limited outbound: procurement requires architecture that supports minimal outbound connectivity and optional air-gap install.
- Network constraints: egress rules restricted, need explicit NAT/Proxy guidance and port list.
- Auditability: long-term audit logs, keys managed by ACME KMS/HSM.

Goals we mapped:
1) Proof-of-concept private deployment in ACME VPC (non-production) with Redwood Private control plane configured for VPC peering or private link.
2) Security review and SOC2 evidence review with your InfoSec.
3) Timeline: pilot within 6-8 weeks if procurement and infra sign-off go smoothly.

Open items / asks from ACME:
- Network diagram & IP/port requirements for infra team.
- Clarify air-gap vs. restricted outbound (is full air-gap mandatory or partial allowed for control plane?).
- Certs/KMS integration details (we can share our KMS integration doc).

Next steps (owner / ETA):
- Camila: share network requirements + draft architecture (attached) — by EOD Tue (04/06).
- Marissa: block time for a technical review with your infra team and prepare SOC2 artifacts — available Wed/Thu next week.
- Jared: confirm whether air-gap is mandatory vs. restricted outbound, and share contact for procurement and network ops.

Attachments: redwood-private-vpc-arch.png (draft architecture), SOC2-Summary.pdf (summary for InfoSec).

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Hi Jared / Camila — looping in a few technical details from our side.

For the pilot with restricted outbound we typically require:
- Outbound to Redwood control-plane endpoints: TCP 443 to a small set of IPs (we’ll provide IP ranges and FQDNs).
- Access to internal container registry (or allow us to push images via your air-gapped registry).
- KMS/HSM integration: we support AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, and customer HSM via standard PKCS11 interfaces; we’ll provide integration guide.
- Audit logs: we can ship logs to your S3-compatible endpoint or push to your SIEM via forwarder.

I’ve attached a short network-requirements.docx and the architecture PNG. We’ll also prepare SOC artifacts and a light SOW for procurement to review.

Proposed next meeting: Technical deep-dive with ACME network and security — Wed 04/07 at 10:00 AM PT. Camila, I’ll send a calendar invite.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
